profile.name: Alex Morgan
profile.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer & Open Source Researcher
profile.bio: Specializing in high-throughput distributed AI pipelines, autonomous agentic runtimes, and low-latency systems. Over 8 years of engineering experience bridging research prototypes into mission-critical cloud infrastructure. Active open-source maintainer and conference speaker.

items.title: Staff AI Systems Engineer & Tech Lead
items.description: Leading the distributed systems team responsible for training and serving large reasoning models. Architected a multi-region inference gateway serving **45M+ daily requests** with sub-40ms P99 latency. Engineered speculative decoding pipelines cutting LLM inference costs by **38%**.

items.title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Architect
items.description: Spearheaded the migration of monolithic microservices into modular Kubernetes clusters with Istio service mesh. Mentored a team of 14 engineers across SRE and platform teams. Designed real-time event streaming architectures using Kafka handling **1.2 TB/hour**.

items.title: Machine Learning Engineer
items.description: Implemented high-precision NLP classification and entity-resolution models for financial intelligence. Built automated CI/CD evaluation pipelines with MLflow and Docker, reducing model deployment cycles from 2 weeks to under **3 hours**.

items.title: Systems Engineering Intern
items.description: Developed optimized C++ data parser utilities for time-series sensor telemetry. Benchmarked database indexing strategies across ClickHouse and TimescaleDB, resulting in a **4x query speedup** for historical aggregations.

items.title: OmniAgent: Distributed Multi-Agent Runtime
items.description: An open-source asynchronous orchestration runtime for autonomous AI agent networks with verifiable execution traces and cryptographic state checkpoints. Reached **2.8k GitHub stars** and actively used in production by 3 fintech startups.

items.title: HyperIndex: Ultra-Low Latency Embedded Vector Index
items.description: SIMD-accelerated Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) vector search engine written in Rust with Python and WebAssembly bindings. Achieved **15% higher recall** than standard FAISS on 1M 768-dim embedding benchmarks.

items.title: SyntaxLens: Interactive AST & Compiler Visualizer
items.description: Browser-based developer tool for live abstract syntax tree introspection and bytecode comparison across V8, PyPy, and Cranelift. Featured in *JavaScript Weekly* and *Hacker News* front page.

items.title: MicroVoice: Local Edge Neural Speech Synthesizer
items.description: Zero-dependency pure browser neural text-to-speech synthesizer running entirely clientside via ONNX Runtime Web. Performs realtime acoustic modeling without transmitting voice data to remote servers.

items.title: Master of Science in Computer Science (Distributed Systems)
items.description: Graduated with Distinction (**GPA 5.8 / 6.0**). Master's thesis on *'Asynchronous Consensus under Network Partitions for Byzantine-Tolerant Replicated State Machines'*, supervised by Prof. T. Hoare Chair. Core coursework in High Performance Computing, Machine Learning, and Cryptographic Protocols.

items.title: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science & Mathematics
items.description: First Class Honours. Awarded the *Class Medal in Systems Programming*. Served as Undergraduate Teaching Assistant for Data Structures & Algorithms and Operating Systems courses.

items.title: Advanced Distributed Machine Learning Systems (CS 329)
items.organization: Stanford Online / Center for Professional Development
items.description: Intensive 10-week post-graduate curriculum covering parameter servers, pipeline parallelism, tensor parallelism (Megatron-LM), and RDMA networking.

items.title: AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional (SAP-C02)
items.description: Comprehensive validation of multi-tier resilient cloud architecture, automated disaster recovery, enterprise security governance, and multi-account cloud topologies.

items.title: Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
items.description: Hands-on performance exam evaluating cluster lifecycle administration, storage networking, ingress controllers, troubleshooting, and production workload orchestration.

items.title: Deep Learning Specialization
items.description: Five-course sequence covering neural network fundamentals, hyperparameter tuning, structuring ML projects, convolutional models, and sequence sequence models.

items.title: Technical Mentor & Grant Application Reviewer
items.description: Providing 1-on-1 technical coaching for junior researchers investigating mechanistic interpretability and model red-teaming. Evaluated over 30 micro-grant submissions for compute resources.

items.title: Open Workshop Lead & Python Instructor
items.description: Organized and delivered 8 free weekend workshops introducing modern Python, Git, and web API development to over 240 career switchers and underrepresented engineers.

items.title: Core Contributor & Relief Mapping Engineer
items.description: Volunteered emergency map layer data-pipelines during natural disaster responses to assist humanitarian logistics coordinators in real-time routing.

items.title: Alpine Trail Running & Ultra-Marathons
items.description: Finisher of the Eiger Ultra Trail 51k and Scenic Trail 54k with over 3,800m vertical ascent. Enduring discipline, pacing strategies, and mental resilience applied directly to long-term engineering challenges.

items.title: Generative Audio & Eurorack Modular Synthesis
items.description: Designing stochastic generative music patches utilizing control voltage (CV), algorithmic step sequencers, and analog filtering circuits. Exploring the intersection of mathematics and harmony.

items.title: Custom Ergonomic Keyboard Design & Micro-soldering
items.description: Hand-soldered split ergonomic mechanical keyboards (Corne & Dactyl ManuForm) with custom ZMK wireless firmware, Colemak-DH layouts, and micro-controller integration.
